# ShotList

> Open-source desktop app (Rust + Tauri 2 + React/TypeScript) for street and documentary photographers: import RAW/JPEG, cull with the keyboard, analyse exposure and focus, develop non-destructively, caption with optional AI, and export a print-ready zine PDF. MIT licensed. No account, server or telemetry.

Install a release on macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2790karthikbhat/ShotList/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
Build from source: `npm run setup` then `npm run dev`. Verify changes: `npm run check`.
